name: Konya Plain
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: -1.2 to -5.2 regional GNSS; > -7.0 in agricultural bowls
agreement_note: 108-day summer peak (-9.6 cm LOS, -12.1 cm vertical est., -32.5 cm/yr LOS est.) is 4-5x higher than multi-year InSAR (> -7.0 cm/yr) due to peak summer agricultural pumping, wide bbox (1.5x0.7 deg), low valid pixel fraction (11.6%), and 0.46 reference sensitivity.
press_summary_gate_note: Do not use -9.6 cm or -32.5 cm/yr in press summary without bbox standardization, full-year seasonal separation, and valid_fraction >= 40%.

first_nisar_measurement.evidence: No peer-reviewed NISAR city-level subsidence publication found for Konya Plain as of 2026-11-14; part of broader multi-basin provisional NISAR evaluation.
first_nisar_measurement.atlas_first_claim_note: Multi-basin standardized atlas phrasing must use qualified (to our knowledge) only after excluding Mexico City from any individual-first claim.

quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
